Week-one item **D** of #221. **Depends on A.** This is the item that first reduces Claude consumption.

## Why this lane is cheap to build

The z.ai GLM Coding Plan speaks an Anthropic-compatible endpoint, so the lane is the `claude` binary with its base URL swapped. That means it reads `CLAUDE.md`, runs `.claude/hooks/` natively, uses `just`, follows the worktree protocol, emits the same OTel with the same event vocabulary, and writes the same session JSONL. **Nothing needs translating, and it has full hook parity by construction** — no `AGENTS.md`, no plugin bridge, no parity suite. All of that is Codex-lane work and is not in week one.

Settled by the sweep: this direction is compliant. Anthropic's Consumer Terms bar reaching the *Anthropic* subscription by non-Anthropic means; this is the reverse, consuming no Anthropic quota, credential or traffic. z.ai documents the configuration itself.

## Scope

- **Credentials**: `~/.arma-cti/credentials.env` at mode 0600, outside every worktree. Exported per invocation only.
- **Lane wiring**: `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic` plus `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL`, set only in the dispatched process.
- **Profile registry entries.** GLM-5.2 has two thinking levels plus off, so Claude Code's five effort levels collapse onto them — `xhigh`, `max` and `ultracode` all reach GLM's Max. Discover which levels are genuinely distinct rather than assuming five profiles exist; if two collapse, they are one profile.
- **Cache TTL choice on this lane.** `ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H=1` opts into the one-hour TTL on a third-party provider. Whether that helps depends on z.ai's metering — if it meters prompts rather than tokens, cache behaviour may be irrelevant there. Establish which, and record it.
- **Metering reality check**: confirm whether a large context genuinely costs nothing extra on this plan. If it does, the economics that govern every Claude decision invert on this lane, and the routing rule should say so.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A dispatch on this lane completes a real issue end to end, under the same gates as any Claude agent
- [ ] `.claude/hooks/` demonstrably fire on this lane — asserted, not assumed
- [ ] No credential appears in `ps`, in a worktree, or in any committed file
- [ ] The profile registry records only genuinely distinct effort levels, with the collapse evidenced
- [ ] The plan's metering unit (prompts or tokens) is established and recorded
- [ ] `just check`, `just unit` green

Refs #221, #195
